page.overview:
Who is Emerald?

Emerald, or Em or Emmy for short, is an animatronic juvenile Velociraptor in Jurassic World: The Exhibition. Emerald was three weeks old.

Similar in color to Gamma, Emerald is slightly different; a dark orange colored body, but still with green-blue stripe-like pattern on her body.
